from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationInfo(BaseModel):
    """One document from the collection, capturing its title and which other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this paper, as written")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers in this collection that this paper explicitly references/cites")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitationInfo]
